It sits BESIDE the tension that req:reflow2-keeps-the-knowledge-it-derives keeps visible ("reflow2 deliberately computes and never stores delivery, the arrival delta and the content manifest … Whether that is enough is Anthony's call"). It does not settle that tension.

WHERE IT CAME FROM: the dev_reflow2 hub's two-agent exercise, 2026-09-28 to 29 (art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, item D13). The OWNER agent of the flo2 design "ideal knowledge graph", deciding under Anthony's delegation for THAT design, ruled on test 4 for the new engine, in its words: "a derived relation is kept when it is cited, recorded or acted on (for example, the blast radius attached to a recorded change), or when recomputing it would break its query budget. Otherwise what is kept is the declared rule, and every computed answer names its rule and its log position." That ruling binds that design only. Here it is an idea.

MEASURED, 2026-09-29 (fact:measured-reflow2s-derived-relations-are-4-percent-of-its-asserted-facts-except-the-impact-closure-2026-09-29): over reflow2's own design, 22 of the 23 derived relations yield 4,463 facts, 4.1% of the 108,400 asserted. The impact closure alone is 118,065 directed pairs (1.09×) and up to 6.47 million undirected (about 60×).

═══ OPTIONS ═══

(a) THE OWNER'S KEEP RULE, as quoted. Keep what somebody cited, recorded or acted on: the blast radius a recorded ChangeEvent was judged against, or the delta at an epoch's arrival. Keep what is too slow to recompute within its query budget. Everything else stays a rule, computed on read, and names its rule and the log position it reflects.
⚠️ Counters:
- "Cited" needs a mechanism that knows a citation happened. Today a citation is prose.
- "Log position" presumes a write clock, and reflow2's core stores no write time (fact:root-cause-no-served-read-answers-since-last-time-2026-09-28), so that half has nothing to point at yet.

(b) CHOSEN PER RESULT, as the requirement words it today: "which results are written back is chosen where a later analysis needs to build on them, and delivery need not be one of them".
⚠️ Counter: with no rule, every addition is a fresh debate, and nothing checks that two kept results were chosen for the same reason.

(c) SIZE DECIDES: keep the 22 small relations (+4%) and compute the closure on demand.
⚠️ Counter: size is not why reflow2 computes and never stores. The reason is that a stored result can drift or be inflated by hand (req:completion-computed). Keeping more multiplies the places a stale value can be read from, unless invalidation is exact.

(d) KEEP NOTHING: compute-never-store stands everywhere.
⚠️ Counter: test 4 of dec:what-a-true-knowledge-graph-is then fails by construction. Its baseline is "0 of 23 kept", and "built on by a later analysis" needs something kept.

🛑 WHAT EVERY OPTION BUT (d) RESTS ON: a kept result is only as honest as its invalidation. The engine that recomputes on a write and is "never served stale" is cap:declared-rules-run-by-an-embedded-datalog-engine-and-updated-by-delta (planned). Before it lands, anything kept is a copy with no guard.
